description: Header file defining the TextToSpeechImplementation class, which implements text-to-speech functionalities, event handling, and notification registration within the WPEFramework Plugin namespace.

classes.name: TextToSpeechImplementation
classes.description: Implements text-to-speech functionalities, event handling, and notification management within the plugin.

classes.name: Job
classes.description: Nested class representing a dispatchable job for handling TTS events asynchronously.

methods.name: Configure
methods.description: Configures the TTS implementation with the given service shell.

methods.name: Register
methods.description: Registers a notification sink for TTS events.

methods.name: RegisterWithCallsign
methods.description: Registers a notification sink associated with a specific callsign.

methods.name: State
methods.description: Returns the current state of the plugin (always RESUMED).

methods.name: Enable
methods.description: Enables or disables the TTS functionality.

methods.name: ListVoices
methods.description: Lists available voices for a specified language.

methods.name: SetFallbackText
methods.description: Sets fallback text for a specific scenario.

methods.name: SetAPIKey
methods.description: Sets the API key for TTS service.

methods.name: SetPrimaryVolDuck
methods.description: Sets the primary volume ducking level.

methods.name: SetACL
methods.description: Sets access control list for methods and applications.

methods.name: Speak
methods.description: Initiates speech synthesis for given text and callsign.

methods.name: Cancel
methods.description: Cancels ongoing speech with specified speech ID.

methods.name: GetSpeechState
methods.description: Retrieves the current state of a speech with given ID.

methods.name: onNetworkError
methods.description: Callback for network errors during speech.
